passive.name: Promise
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **16/19/22/25/28%**. While the wearer is in battle, for every **20%** CRIT DMG that exceeds **120%**, the DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). When the battle starts or after the wearer uses their Basic ATK, enables the DMG dealt by Ultimate or Follow-Up ATK to ignore **20/24/28/32/36%** of the target's DEF, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Long Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Skill and Ultimate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate, gains "Somnus Corpus." Upon triggering a Follow-Up ATK, consumes "Somnus Corpus," and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **48/56/64/72/80%**.

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Meteor Swarm
passive.text: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by **9/10.5/12/13.5/15%**, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **30/35/40/45/50%** for 1 turn.

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Get Ready
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by **4/5/6/7/8%**, stacking up to **3** time(s).

passive.name: The Maiden in the Painting
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by **24/30/36/42/48%**. If the current HP percentage of the enemy target is below or equal to **50%**, increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by an extra **24/30/36/42/48%**.

substatLine: CRIT RATE >= CRIT DMG > ATK% > SPD
tracePriority: Collateral Ticket (A4) > Reverse Repo (A2) > Asset Forfeiture (A4)

entries.name: Lash of Riches
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **90%** of Jade's ATK to one designated enemy target, and Quantum DMG equal to **30%** of Jade's ATK to adjacent enemies.

entries.name: Acquisition Surety
entries.text:
Makes a single target ally become the Debt Collector and increases their SPD by **30**, lasting for **3** turn(s).
After the Debt Collector attacks, deals 1 instance of Quantum Additional DMG equal to **25%** of Jade's ATK to each enemy target hit, and consumes the Debt Collector's HP by an amount equal to **2%** of their Max HP. If the current HP is insufficient, reduces HP to 1.
If Jade becomes the Debt Collector, she cannot gain the SPD boost effect, and her attacks do not consume HP.
When the Debt Collector exists on the field, Jade cannot use her Skill. At the start of Jade's every turn, the Debt Collector's duration decreases by 1 turn.

entries.name: Vow of the Deep
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **240%** of Jade's ATK to all enemies. At the same time, Jade enhances her Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increasing its DMG multiplier by **80%**. This enhancement can take effect **2** time(s).

entries.name: Fang of Flare Flaying
entries.text:
After Jade or the "Debt Collector" unit attacks, gains 1 point of Charge for each enemy target hit. Upon reaching **8** points of Charge, consumes the **8** points to launch 1 instance of Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to **120%** of Jade's ATK to all enemies. This Follow-Up ATK does not generate Charge.
When launching her Talent's Follow-Up ATK, Jade immediately gains **5** stack(s) of "Pawned Asset," with each stack increasing CRIT DMG by **2.4%**, stacking up to **50** times.

entries.name: Visionary Predation
entries.text: After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with Blind Fealty for **10** second(s). Enemies inflicted with Blind Fealty will not initiate attacks on allies. When entering battle via actively attacking enemies inflicted with Blind Fealty, all enemies with Blind Fealty will enter combat simultaneously. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to **50%** of Jade's ATK to all enemies, and immediately gains **15** stack(s) of Pawned Asset.

entries.name: Reverse Repo
entries.text: When an enemy target enters combat, Jade gains **1** stack(s) of Pawned Asset. When the Debt Collector character's turn starts, additionally gains **3** stack(s) of Pawned Asset.

entries.name: Collateral Ticket
entries.text: When the battle starts, action advances Jade by **50%**.

entries.name: Asset Forfeiture
entries.text: Each Pawned Asset stack from the Talent additionally increases Jade's ATK by **0.5%**.

entries.name: Altruism? Nevertheless Tradable
entries.text: The Follow-Up ATK DMG from Jade's Talent increases by 32%. After the "Debt Collector" character attacks and the number of the enemy target(s) hit is either 2 or 1, Jade additionally gains 1 or 2 point(s) of Charge respectively.

entries.name: Morality? Herein Authenticated
entries.text: When there are 15 stacks of Pawned Asset, Jade's CRIT Rate increases by 18%.

entries.name: Honesty? Soon Mortgaged
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Sincerity? Put Option Only
entries.text: When using Ultimate, enables the DMG dealt by Jade to ignore 12% of enemy targets' DEF, lasting for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Hope? Hitherto Forfeited
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Equity? Pending Sponsorship
entries.text: While the "Debt Collector" character exists on the field, Jade's Quantum RES PEN increases by 20%, and Jade gains the "Debt Collector" state.

items.name: Lost Echo of the Shared Wish
